description: This file declares the class EinsumSPMDExpander, which is a specialization of SPMDExpanderBase for handling einsum operations in TensorFlow's distributed tensor (DTENSOR) MLIR expansion framework. It includes method declarations for expanding operations and computing layouts, as well as a private helper method for input relayout logic.
external_methods: MaybeRelayoutInputs(const std::vector<Layout>&, mlir::Operation*, const Layout&, absl::flat_hash_set<std::string>&, Layout&, std::vector<mlir::Value>&)

classes.name: EinsumSPMDExpander
classes.description: A class that handles the expansion and layout computation for einsum operations within TensorFlow's MLIR DTENSOR framework.

methods.name: ExpandOp
methods.description: Expands the given MLIR operation into its distributed form.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutForward
methods.description: Computes the layout of inputs based on the operation and input layouts.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutBackward
methods.description: Computes the layout of outputs given the operation and output layouts.

methods.name: MaybeRelayoutInputs
methods.description: Determines whether inputs need to be sliced or concatenated to match the desired einsum output layout, and prepares the new inputs.
